description: Agent Triage: submit the stated routing rules with where each queue item was routed: each rule with its id, the class of item it routes, the queue and the owner it routes to; and each item with its id, the class it was sorted into, the queue and owner it was routed to, the id of the rule applied, the routing reason recorded on the item and how many times it was moved after its first route. The signed report gives every rule, every item with the queue and owner its rule names and its status as routed, overridden, partly_routed, misrouted, unrouted or unexplained, and counts the items routed by rule, misrouted, overridden and carrying a reason, and names misrouted items: items that went to another queue or owner than their rule names with no recorded reason, and items routed to no queue and no owner; then routes with no reason on the item, owners named as a team, someone or TBD, and items moved twice or more after their first route, with the fix for each. An item that departs from its rule with a recorded reason is an override. This reads incoming items assigned to queues and owners, a sorting decision rather than a delegation: why a router or marketplace chose one seller is wever_router-disclosure-check, routing delivered watch fires and job results is wever_alert-route, and the written bounds of one delegation are wever_delegation-scope-check. Verdict misrouted_items, routing_partial, routing_unexplained or routing_sound. POST /api/triage-routing-check. Reads only the recorded queue items and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no item is captured, ranked, routed, escalated or closed and no queue is changed. Agent Triage reads how an agent sorts incoming work, from the item captured at intake to the disposition it ends with: it is not multi-agent coordination (how a group of agents organizes shared work, with its own escalation path, the wever_coordination checks; triage escalation is a single queue item breaching its threshold and moving up a tier, with its context attached), not the promises an agent has made (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; triage decides handling order and routing before any promise exists), not delegation (handing work off with authority, the wever_delegation checks; triage assigns incoming items to queues and owners, a sorting decision rather than a delegation) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the triage checks read a queue of items over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-triage-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-triage/.
